Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kerravon wrote:
>
> If I delaying tactics someone else's vote can I then play a politcal backlash?

No.

1) Card text on PB is "when a <referendum> fails". The referendum hasn't failed.
2) Can't play reaction cards after the action is canceled - there's no action
left to react to.
